That means that the terrorist attacks on American soil in 2001 are under the same category as the Gulf War of 1991. So, by tat logic, and extrapolating some speculation a little bit, one can assume that we have been engaged under some pretense of a "war" since 1991. I only say this because there was not check-box for Operation Enduring Freedom or any major military campaign in Afghanistan, Pakistan, Yemen, Somalia, or other African nations. We are simply in an "never-ending" war for Veterans after 1991, and especially after 2001. I do not see this changing anytime soon. Therefore, any future wars to break out will be indirectly because of whatever happened in 1991 in the Middle East.

 

  1. Cyber warfare - When I was writing a paper in a college class about cyber terrorism in 1999 (I wish I had evidence to back this up, please believe me that at least my teach had me explain to her what the word "cyber" meant,)

Back them computer viruses were relegated to physical transport of one computer to another and hooking it up to the network. Now it seems clear, in 2015, that cyber warfare can anytime, anywhere, and at anyplace without warning and will be that way for the foreseeable future. I wrote about people were going to terrorize us in the way of information and request we "owe" them something for their trouble (ransomeware), I touched on using popular website to spread disinformation (trolling and IP squatting - and to a more indirect point -- social media,) and I touched on why governments and terrorists and activists alike were going to use technology to hide themselves to spread their own version of "attacks" (Using TOR / security protocols to be untraceable.)
